title: 축하해요! 입학해요? 못해요: ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ + ㅎ 소리
objective: You can read 축하, 입학, and 못해요 aloud as [추카], [이팍], and [모태요].
summary: A final ㄱ, ㄷ (or ㅅ), or ㅂ followed by ㅎ becomes one strong sound: ㅋ, ㅌ, or ㅍ.

task.title: Read the strong sounds
task.line: Find the final consonant before ㅎ, join the two into one strong sound, and write or choose it.

words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling starts school in March.

words.meaning: can't do (it), am not able to

letters.as: Final ㄱ meets ㅎ and becomes ㅋ, like k in 'kite'.
Final ㅅ sounds like ㄷ; with ㅎ it becomes ㅌ, like t in 'top'.
Final ㅂ meets ㅎ and becomes ㅍ, like p in 'pen'.

exercises: Write how you say it in [ ]: ① 국화 ② 부탁해요 ③ 대답해요
Which sound do you hear, ㅋ, ㅌ, or ㅍ? ① 비슷해요 ② 약해요 ③ 밥해요
Does the sound become ㅋ, ㅌ, or ㅍ here? Write Yes or No: ① 전화 ② 급히 ③ 영화
Choose the right sound for the word given before the brackets: ① 졸업 축하해요. (축하해요: [축하해요] / [추카해요]) ② 저는 운전을 못해요. (못해요: [모새요] / [모태요]) ③ 입학 선물이에요. (입학: [입학] / [이팍])
answers: ① ㅌ ② ㅋ ③ ㅍ
① No ② Yes [그피] ③ No
